h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Indore

items.pText: Indore is about 480 km from our factory in Vasai East, one of the shorter trips we make into Madhya Pradesh. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, townships, housing societies and public gardens in Indore. We send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a dealer, self-standing or grouted depending on your ground.

As the commercial centre of the state, Indore has townships coming up along the bypass and the Super Corridor, along with schools across the city. Its gardens fill with families every evening. Industrial areas such as Pithampur, close to the city, also have staff housing that needs a play area. We plan each site from its size, the age groups and photos, and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Black soil and how it affects installation

c: Much of the Malwa plateau has black cotton soil, which swells when wet and shrinks and cracks as it dries. Equipment set directly in this soil can tilt over a few seasons. For grouted posts we suggest a firm, compacted base, and on large sites your civil contractor may want to replace the top layer with murrum or another stable fill.

Where the play area sits on a paved surface or a podium, a self-standing installation avoids the problem. Share photos and a short description of the ground, and we will recommend the method that suits it.

Indore is milder than much of Madhya Pradesh, with pleasant evenings even in summer, though April and May afternoons are still hot. Shade over slides and decks keeps them comfortable. The monsoon, from late June to September, turns black soil sticky and slippery, so a raised base with rubber flooring keeps children off the mud.

Winters are cool and dry, which makes them a good time for installation work. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts last well across these seasons and carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment in Indore?
items.a: Yes. Indore is about 480 km from our Vasai factory by road. We manufacture the equipment there, dispatch it to your site and install it through our own team or a local dealer.

items.q: Will black cotton soil affect the playground?
items.a: It can, because the soil moves as it gets wet and dries out. A compacted base or stable fill under grouted posts helps, and a self-standing base works on paved ground. We suggest the method after seeing photos.

items.q: Can you supply play equipment for a township park?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the park dimensions and which age groups will use it. We usually suggest a themed main structure plus a toddler corner, and send a layout drawing showing the clear space needed around each piece.

items.q: Do you also supply nearby towns like Dewas and Ujjain?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road across the Malwa region, including Dewas, Ujjain and Pithampur, and install through our own team or a dealer. The process and warranty are the same as for Indore.
